nubsNob.comments:
We're open this weekend! 🎄

There isn't enough snow for skiing yet, but the Lodge, General Store, Tune Center, Cafeteria, Pub, and Locker Room are open today and Saturday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.

Stop by to:

Do some Christmas shopping.

Organize your locker.

Pick up your season pass.

Drop off your equipment for a tune.

Enjoy a warm bowl of soup.

Watch Michigan vs. Ohio State in Nub's Pub on Saturday 🏈

Think cold and snow! ❄️
